Each GenSet manufactured at the Vicenza plant is not just a product but the result of a commitment to innovation and quality.
Perkins, Ftp, Kohler, Doosan, Deutz, Volvo, Yanmar, Cummins, Mitsubishi, Scania and Baudouin.
